mapper.select: SELECT DETAIL.SUBJECT_NO AS subjectNo, DETAIL.SUBJECT_NAME AS subjectName, DETAIL.CD_FLAG AS cdFlag, DETAIL.CCY AS ccy, DETAIL.O_HAPPEN_AMT AS happenAmt, DETAIL.B_CCY AS bCcy, DETAIL.B_HAPPEN_AMT AS bHappenAmt, DETAIL.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS happenNumber FROM TRD_VOUCH_DEAL_DETAIL DETAIL WHERE DETAIL.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
